name_en: Hage dango — new-wheat dumplings mottled with sweet red bean paste
summary_ja: 収穫したての小麦粉でつくった団子を、小豆であんをまぶした素朴な菓子。梅雨明けの節目にあたる半夏生（7月2日ごろ）に農作業をねぎらってつくり、神仏に供えて家族で食べる。
summary_en: Freshly milled new-wheat dumplings are coated in a simple red-bean paste. Traditionally made around Hangeshō, the early-July turning point when the rains break, as thanks for the season's farm work, and offered to household gods before the family eats.
source_title: はげ団子 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Ochirashi ame — roasted barley candy pulled into sticks
summary_ja: はだか麦ともち米を煎って粉にした「おちらし」を水あめと砂糖で練り上げ、棒状にして切り分ける菓子。米の裏作として麦づくりが盛んな香川で、初夏の麦の収穫に合わせてつくられてきたという。
summary_en: Ochirashi, a roasted flour made from hulless barley and glutinous rice, is kneaded with starch syrup and sugar, then shaped into sticks and cut. Made to mark the early-summer barley harvest in Kagawa, where barley has long been grown as a second crop after rice.
source_title: おちらしあめ 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Uzumaki mochi — sweet red bean paste rolled inside a spiral of dumpling dough
summary_ja: こしあんを蒸しただんご生地で巻き込み、断面が渦になるよう巻いた東かがわ市引田の郷土菓子。渦は鳴門の海を表すとされ、女児の初節句の雛飾りに、菱餅と同じように供えて食べられてきたという。
summary_en: Steamed dumpling dough is rolled around sweet red bean paste so the cut cross-section forms a spiral, in this specialty of Hiketa, Higashikagawa. The spiral is said to represent the whirlpools of nearby Naruto, and the sweet has long been displayed and eaten at a baby girl's first Girls' Festival, alongside diamond-shaped rice cakes.
source_title: うずまきもち 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
